market.question: Will Crude Oil (CL) hit (LOW) $80 by end of June?

assessment.reasoning: WTI front-month CL ~$99.32-$99.58 on Apr 29, 2026. Geopolitical tightness (Strait of Hormuz disruption, Iran/US tensions) is supporting prices around $95-$100. Reaching $80 settle requires ~19% drop with ~2 months left and supply shock backdrop. Possible if ceasefire holds and demand softens, but base rate for that magnitude move down in 2 months given current drivers is low.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether the Hormuz disruption/Iran-US standoff resolves quickly, releasing the geopolitical premium.
